patch.value: Investigate Windows sharing-violation incumbent lock classification

PR #60 CI run 37463670264, Rust windows-latest job 112269223502: a real incumbent lock held through OpenOptionsExt::share_mode(0) refuses reading, but acquire_lock_attempt does not return LockConflict. The classifier accepts AlreadyExists, PermissionDenied and NotFound; sharing violation is a distinct OS error. Investigate contention classification without hiding corrupt-lock or directory faults. Coverage work uses a real pending-delete incumbent to exercise the existing PermissionDenied arm.

Reproduce the returned typed error and raw Windows code with an exclusive second handle; classify genuine sharing contention without weakening structural/corrupt lock errors; validate on Windows and retain complete coverage
